# version
# Betaflight / STM32F405 (S405) 4.4.3 Oct 23 2026 / 07:45:27 (norevision) MSP API: 1.45

# start the command batch
batch start

# reset configuration to default settings
defaults nosave

board_name SPEEDYBEEF405V4
manufacturer_id SPBE
mcu_id 000000000000000100000002
signature 

# resources
resource LED_STRIP 1 A08

# timer
timer A08 AF1
# pin A08: TIM1 CH1 (AF1)

# dma
dma pin A08 0
# pin A08: DMA2 Stream 6 Channel 0

# feature
feature GPS
feature LED_STRIP
feature -RX_SERIAL
feature RX_MSP

# beeper
beeper -CRASH_FLIP
beeper -RC_SMOOTHING_INIT_FAIL
beeper -ON_USB

# beacon
beacon RX_LOST

# map
map TAER1234

# serial
serial 0 2 115200 57600 0 115200
serial 1 64 115200 57600 0 115200
serial 2 131073 115200 57600 0 115200

# aux
aux 0 0 0 1700 2100 0 0
aux 1 1 1 1300 1700 0 0
aux 2 35 2 1700 2100 0 0

# adjrange
adjrange 0 0 3 1700 2100 29 3 0 0
adjrange 1 0 3 900 1300 25 3 0 0

# rxfail
rxfail 4 s 1500

# master
set mag_hardware = QMC5883
set debug_mode = D_MIN
set acc_hardware = FAKE
set dshot_idle_value = 450
set serialrx_provider = CRSF
set gps_rescue_throttle_hover = 300
set iterm_limit = 300
set abs_control_gain = 5
set expresslrs_uid = 41,42,43,44,45,46
set bat_capacity = 1500
set vbat_max_cell_voltage = 435
set osd_vbat_pos = 2465
set craft_name = RESTORE

profile 0

# profile 0
set p_roll = 50
set d_roll = 35
set d_min_roll = 25
set simplified_dmax_gain = 90
set angle_level_strength = 60
set level_limit = 60
set horizon_transition = 70
set feedforward_jitter_factor = 10

profile 1

# profile 1
set p_roll = 55
set d_roll = 35
set d_min_roll = 25
set simplified_dmax_gain = 90
set angle_level_strength = 60
set level_limit = 60
set horizon_transition = 70
set feedforward_jitter_factor = 10

# restore original profile selection
profile 0

rateprofile 0

# rateprofile 0
set rates_type = ACTUAL
set roll_rc_rate = 12

# restore original rateprofile selection
rateprofile 0

# save configuration
save
